content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** § 19.2 was a material deviation — it limited the Deliverable/software conformance warranty to fifteen days and cut off any correction or refund obligation thereafter, well below the 90-day fallback floor. The supporting provisions were already adequate: § 19.1 carries untimed professional/workmanlike and conformance warranties (Services include hosted software), § 19.3 covers Applicable Law compliance and malicious code, § 19.4 supplies re-perform/repair/replace plus a refund of Fees paid, and § 19.5 expressly preserves the express warranties against the disclaimer.

**Redline:** one surgical change — "For fifteen days after delivery" → "For ninety days after delivery" — bringing the clause to the fallback position without disturbing any other language.
